name: '97 Interstate Benson
summary: The '97 Interstate Benson is a truck listed in the released game's vehicle database (era 1990s Classic).
body: DayOne's list of the game's vehicles files it under Trucks.

GTABase lists 2 seats and AWD drive for the Interstate Benson '97.

name: Vapid Guardian TX2
summary: The Vapid Guardian TX2 is a truck listed in the released game's vehicle database (era 2010s Current).
body: DayOne's list of the game's vehicles files it under Trucks.
DayOne gives its stats as speed 2.6, acceleration 2.1, asphalt handling 2.6, off-road handling 3.4, strength 3.0.
GTA Wiki (edited November 19, 2026) calls the Vapid Guardian TX2 a chassis cab truck new to GTA VI, pictured on its page as a box truck; it names the D7700 as a similar truck.

name: Jobuilt MB2-10
summary: The Jobuilt MB2-10 is a truck listed in the released game's vehicle database (era 2000s Modern).
body: DayOne's list of the game's vehicles files it under Trucks.
DayOne gives its stats as speed 1.8, acceleration 1.4, asphalt handling 2.2, off-road handling 2.2, strength 3.0.

GTA Wiki (edited November 19, 2026) describes the Jobuilt MB2-10 as a heavy chassis cab truck with dual rear wheels on a tandem axle, found with an aerial work platform, box body, flatbed or tanker body.
According to GTA Wiki, part of an MB2-10 with a tanker body is visible at Jack of Hearts in the official video An Extended Look.
